messages.subject: Verdant v Calderhall - case update and cost estimate to trial
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Rohan,

A short update following the CMC on 8 October. We have directions to a 5-day TCC trial in a window opening 19 April 2027. Disclosure is due 12 December, witness statements 13 February, and expert reports in spring. Counsel assesses liability prospects at 75-80% and a realistic risk-adjusted recovery of 1.9-2.1m plus interest and costs.

Our estimated costs from now to the end of disclosure are in the region of 95k-115k plus VAT, and to the end of trial preparation 280k-330k plus VAT, excluding counsel's and the expert's fees. We'll keep this under review and recommend exploring mediation after expert reports.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
www.whitfieldcarter.com

Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Thanks Sarah. The numbers are within what the board expected. Please do keep pushing for early disclosure of their batch records - if those show a process excursion, I'd expect them to want to settle before trial. Rohan Bhatt | CFO | Verdant Energy Systems
